nodes.name: rag_enhancement.md
nodes.summary: Describes the enhanced agentic RAG architecture as a LangGraph state machine with six nodes (rewrite_query, retrieve_and_rerank, grade_chunks, rewrite_and_retry, generate_answer, faithfulness_check), documents the OpenRouter model cutover (Claude Haiku 4.5 chat/rerank, Qwen3 embeddings), the parent/child chunk data model, evaluation harness, and tunable config knobs.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes an ASCII flow diagram of the LangGraph node transitions and a module-to-responsibility table used as the canonical reference for the RAG pipeline's file layout.

nodes.name: planing.md
nodes.summary: Initial feature request for document upload and background ingestion: an upload button in the chat UI, storing document metadata in Postgres, and a background job that chunks, embeds, and stores vectors in pgvector before notifying the user.

nodes.name: nginx.conf
nodes.summary: Nginx reverse proxy configuration that serves the built frontend as an SPA, proxies /api/ requests to the FastAPI backend with buffering disabled for streaming responses, and sets long-lived caching headers for static assets.
nodes.languageNotes: Disables proxy_buffering for /api/ so server-sent-event streaming responses from the backend reach the client without being buffered.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: Standalone FastAPI OCR microservice exposing a health check and an /ocr endpoint that runs RapidOCR (ONNXRuntime) over an uploaded image and returns line-level text, bounding boxes, and confidence scores.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads the RapidOCR engine once at process start to avoid per-request model load latency; kept separate from the Celery worker so the worker calls it over HTTP instead of importing PaddleOCR directly.

nodes.name: ocr
nodes.summary: Reads an uploaded image, runs it through RapidOCR, and returns recognized text lines with bounding boxes and confidence scores alongside the image dimensions.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Pinned Python dependencies for the OCR microservice: FastAPI, Uvicorn, python-multipart, RapidOCR (ONNXRuntime), Pillow, and NumPy.

nodes.name: App.css
nodes.summary: Legacy create-vite scaffold styles (counter button, hero/logo layout, ticking animation) that appear to predate the chat UI rewrite and are no longer referenced from App.jsx.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet entry point that imports src/styles/global.css, pulled in by main.jsx to bootstrap the app's base styles.

nodes.name: global.css
nodes.summary: Base global stylesheet applying a CSS reset, body typography/background driven by design tokens, and default button/input/link resets; imports tokens.css.

nodes.name: tokens.css
nodes.summary: CSS custom-property design tokens (Apple-Blue brand colors, backgrounds, text colors, radii, shadows, typography, and layout widths) shared across the app's stylesheets.

nodes.name: vite.config.js
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration registering the React plugin and proxying /api requests to the local FastAPI backend during development.
